title: GitHub - mindcloud-inc/universal-api-reference: One consistent API reference for 3,000+ APIs for developers and AI agents.
excerpt: One consistent API reference for 3,000+ APIs for developers and AI agents. - mindcloud-inc/universal-api-reference
content_html:
The API surface of 3,192 apps — 75,506 endpoints — documented in one uniform, greppable format. Every app gets the same treatment: authentication, pagination, filtering, sorting, argument conventions, response formats, and a mapping back to the vendor's native API. One file per endpoint.

git clone https://github.com/mindcloud-inc/universal-api-reference.git

# every app that can issue a refund
rg -l "refund" apis

# how a specific API paginates, straight from the spec
rg "pagination" apis/s/stripe/universal-api/README.md -A 3

Why this exists

APIs are filthy things. If there is one true REST standard, precious few companies have ever fully followed it. Every vendor invents its own pagination, its own filtering syntax, its own creative interpretation of HTTP status codes. This repo documents all of them the same way, so you don't have to be a specialist in a system to consume its API:

  • Request & response formats and datatypes
  • Pagination
  • Filtering & sorting
  • HTTP methods & status codes
  • Native-API mapping (endpoint, quirks, source docs)

Averaged out, that's ~23.7 documented endpoints per app — most integration platforms cover 7–8.

What's in this repo

  • apis/<letter>/<api>/universal-api/ — the Universal API README, auth, pagination, filtering, sorting, argument conventions, examples, and one file per action.
  • apis/<letter>/<api>/native-api/ — the vendor-native API README and one file per native operation.
  • catalog.json — machine-readable catalog of all 3,192 apps, with per-letter shards under catalog/.
  • indexes/ — app indexes by category, API specification, and native-docs link.
  • llms.txt — index of this repo for LLM ingestion.
  • indexes/api-specifications.md — generated Universal API OpenAPI files and provider-published Native API specifications.
  • indexes/native-api-docs.md — the vendors' own API documentation, one link per app.

Example: one endpoint file

Stripe: Cancel Payment Intent

Cancels an existing payment intent in Stripe.

PUT https://connect.mindcloud.co/v1/universal/stripe/latest/actions/cancel-payment-intent

Native API mapping: POST payment_intents/:intent/cancel — vendor documentation.

Where these docs come from

This is not scraped documentation. It's a nightly mirror of the machine-readable spec that drives MindCloud's integration gateway — the product of years of building and validating app integrations, and the same spec its production systems execute API calls against at a run rate of ~1.85 billion per year. When a doc is wrong, real workflows break, and the spec gets fixed. Changes land here as daily commits, so you can watch it evolve in the history.

Full disclosure: MindCloud sells a Universal API and MCP that can call every endpoint in this repo through one interface.

Ways to use it

  • Native API reference — integrating directly with an app? Each endpoint file documents the native endpoint, arguments, pagination, and quirks, with links to source docs. No account, no SDK, no gateway required.
  • Agent context — point your agent or RAG pipeline at llms.txt and catalog.json, or vendor the folders for the apps you care about.
  • Grep across every API at once — find every app with a refund endpoint, every API that paginates by cursor, every endpoint that touches invoice.
  • Unified API / MCP — if you'd rather call all 3,192 apps through one REST signature and auth model, that's the hosted thing.

content_html_zh:
3,192 个应用程序的 API 界面（75,506 个端点）以一种统一的、可 grep 格式记录。 每个应用程序都得到相同的处理：身份验证、分页、过滤、排序、参数约定、响应格式以及映射回供应商的本机 API。 每个端点一个文件。

git clone https://github.com/mindcloud-inc/universal-api-reference.git

# every app that can issue a refund
rg -l "refund" apis

# how a specific API paginates, straight from the spec
rg "pagination" apis/s/stripe/universal-api/README.md -A 3

为什么存在这个

API 是肮脏的东西。 如果存在一个真正的 REST 标准，那么很少有公司能够完全遵循它。 每个供应商都发明了自己的分页、自己的过滤语法、自己对 HTTP 状态代码的创造性解释。 此存储库以相同的方式记录所有这些内容，因此您不必是系统专家即可使用其 API：

  • 请求和响应格式和数据类型
  • 分页
  • 过滤和排序
  • HTTP 方法和状态代码
  • 本机 API 映射（端点、怪癖、源文档）

平均而言，每个应用程序约有 23.7 个已记录的端点 - 大多数集成平台涵盖 7-8 个。

这个仓库里有什么

  • apis/<letter>/<api>/universal-api/ — 通用 API 自述文件、身份验证、分页、过滤、排序、参数约定、示例和每个操作一个文件。
  • apis/<letter>/<api>/native-api/ — 供应商本机 API 自述文件和每个本机操作一个文件。
  • Catalog.json — 所有 3,192 个应用程序的机器可读目录，每个字母的分片位于目录/下。
  • indexs/ — 按类别、API 规范和本机文档链接划分的应用程序索引。
  • llms.txt — 用于 LLM 摄取的此存储库的索引。
  • indexs/api-specations.md — 生成的通用 API OpenAPI 文件和提供商发布的本机 API 规范。
  • indexs/native-api-docs.md — 供应商自己的 API 文档，每个应用程序一个链接。

示例：一个端点文件

Stripe：取消付款意向

取消 Stripe 中现有的付款意向。

PUT https://connect.mindcloud.co/v1/universal/stripe/latest/actions/cancel-payment-intent

本机 API 映射：POST payment_intents/:intent/cancel — 供应商文档。

这些文档来自哪里

这不是抄袭文档。 它是驱动 MindCloud 集成网关的机器可读规范的夜间镜像，这是多年来构建和验证应用程序集成的产品，其生产系统以每年约 18.5 亿的运行率执行 API 调用。 当文档错误时，真正的工作流程就会中断，规范就会得到修复。 每日提交都会发生变化，因此您可以看到它在历史中的演变。

全面披露：MindCloud 销售通用 API 和 MCP，可以通过一个接口调用此存储库中的每个端点。

使用方法

  • 本机 API 参考 — 直接与应用程序集成？ 每个端点文件都记录了本机端点、参数、分页和怪癖，以及源文档的链接。 无需账户，无需SDK，无需网关。
  • 代理上下文 - 将您的代理或 RAG 管道指向 llms.txt 和 Catalog.json，或者向您提供您关心的应用程序的文件夹。
  • 一次对每个 API 进行 Grep — 查找每个具有退款端点的应用程序、每个按光标分页的 API、每个涉及发票的端点。
  • 统一 API / MCP — 如果您希望通过一个 REST 签名和身份验证模型调用所有 3,192 个应用程序，那么这就是托管的东西。
